facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: The big storm was gone now. Sunshine returned to the farm. The friends planned a small party. Wooly hung paper garlands. Penny brought a basket of flowers. Gigi sang a happy goose song. Daisy mooed to start the music. They celebrated.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: After the storm came many sunny, golden days. The five friends decided to hold a small party in the yard to thank everyone who had been brave. Wooly and Pip hung colorful paper garlands between the apple trees, and Penny brought wildflowers for the table — daisies, poppies, and bright yellow buttercups. Gigi set out little wooden plates with apples, berries, and a loaf of bread. A soft breeze carried laughter through the field, mixing with the songs of birds. Even the duckling they had rescued waddled around happily, fully dry and safe. They celebrated, and the yard felt golden.
